caption:
New year, new resolution? Try one movement goal you'll actually keep.

"Get fit" is hard to act on. "Walk 30 minutes before work on weekdays" or "two strength sessions a week" tells you exactly what to do. Write down why it matters, like keeping up with the kids or hiking a favourite track.

Start smaller than you think, and plan a 10-minute version for busy weeks so the habit survives. Take a minute each month to review and adjust rather than giving up.

If you're coming back after a long break or have an ongoing niggle, an assessment first can help shape the plan. Our team at Hybrid Physio can help you set a realistic goal. Book online via the link in bio.
